How it works

Agents do the work. You make the calls.

Your executive agents sit around one table, each with a job. You sit at the head: their plans come to you, and nothing goes out until you approve it.

  1. 01

    Tell us about your business

    A guided profile: your offer, customers, numbers and goals.

  2. 02

    Agents plan and do the work

    Your founder agent sets the plan; executive agents carry it out.

  3. 03

    You approve what goes out

    Customer messages and spending wait for your yes.

  4. 04

    Results improve every week

    Outcomes are measured and the agents learn from your edits.

Autonomy is earned: each kind of task runs on its own only after you have approved enough of its work.
